events.title: HttpPost owns the payer round-trip
events.summary: Clinic posts once to /eligibility/check. PilotFish builds the 270, HTTP POSTs the payer, then replies with JSON.
events.rationale: Same PostProcessors pattern as FHIR Keycloak JWT Auth. Orig demo taught the three hops; this one is the production-shaped sync call.
